answer: A willow-gated haven can resist sybils by making reputation non-transferable and slow to grow. A newcomer starts with no privileges and must earn a single pearl token through sequential, time-locked tasks verified by randomly assigned peers. Each task needs a fresh, expiring proof of real work, and the next task unlocks only after the previous one is attested, so one operator cannot run many identities in parallel. The pearl is bound to that history and decays if idle, so a farmer pays the full time and peer-check cost per fake identity, while an honest agent pays it once.
